author: Ryan Marion
title: 17-year-old dead after deadly crash on Bangerter Highway, Eastbound closed - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Marion ,
12 hours ago All traffic eastbound on Bangerter Highway is closed near 2700 West in Bluffdale after a crash.
At 7:00 p.m., a motorcycle with a single male occupant collided with the crash attenuator on the eastboubd ramp to Bangerter Highway at 2700 West.
The driver, a 17-year-old, had attempted to make an illegal turn when they crashed. He was pronounced dead at the scene.
Ogden teen shot outside school had 'biggest heart,' family shares
Ogden teen shot outside school had 'biggest heart,' family sharesOfficials confirmed the motorcycle driver, male, passed away. No other vehicles were involved in the crash.
All traffic eastbound is expected to remain closed for several hours during the investigation. The cause of the crash is not known.
